Red (Starter)

Red Group is perfect for anyone who is new to ride days or to this track. Offering overtaking rules to give you confidence and a Champion's marshal leading out the group to give you the riding lines and warm up your tyres, we've got your back! Plus the Red Group has a specific, additional Riders Briefing tailored to new riders to encourage questions and give you tips.

Available

Green (Intermediate Slow)

Green Group is perfect for anyone who is new or recent to ride days or to this track. Offering overtaking rules to give you confidence and a Champion's marshal leading out the group to give you the riding lines and warm up your tyres, we've got your back! Plus the Green Group has a specific, additional Riders Briefing tailored to riders to encourage questions and give you tips.

Available

Blue (Intermediate Fast)

Blue Group is perfect for an intermediate-fast road rider who is familiar with this track. With no overtaking rules to give you the best fun on track possible!

Available

Yellow (Fast/Racer)

Yellow Group is for the fast road & track rider who is familiar with this track. With no overtaking rules to give you the best fun on track possible! To be in the Fast group you must hold consistent pace on track.

Available

About

We love to ride! Champion’s Ride Days wants everyone to love their bike and enjoy it to the max. The best way to do this is on the track. For over 25 years, we have provided professional, safe and fun ride days for bike enthusiasts across Australia. Just turn your mirrors in and you are on the track! No speed cameras, trucks, driveways or dogs here!
